key_insight: MedCTA shows that even strong multimodal medical AI models often fail when they must plan, choose tools, and complete multi-step clinical workflows.
clinical_relevance: The benchmark helps identify where clinical AI agents break down in realistic, clinician-validated tasks so safer, more reliable tool-using systems can be developed.
method: Clinician-verified executable trajectories across 5 deployed tools
Process-aware evaluation of tool choice, argument validity, execution stability, trajectory fidelity, and outcome quality
evidence_signal: The study benchmarks 18 open- and closed-source multimodal models and finds autonomous rollouts are often derailed by protocol failures, premature stopping, and incorrect tool recruitment.
watch_item: Performance on this benchmark may not fully capture real clinical deployment challenges, such as integration into workflow, local tool availability, and changing patient context.
paper_title: MedCTA: A Benchmark for Clinical Tool Agents
